bibl.seg: 141.4 P. Laur. Inv. III/1010 = P. Capasso 4
Lucio Del Corso, PL III/1010. Parte finale di documento con sottoscrizione (P.Capasso 4).
Paola Davoli & Natascia Pellé (edd.), Πολυμάθεια. Studi Classici offerti a Mario Capasso (Lecce, 2018) pp. 29-34, fig.
bibl.note: Found in Tebtynis by C. Anti in 1931. Dated to 186/187. The handwriting of the main text is an early example of a well known chancery script, especially attested from the beginning of the 3rd century AD.
